_README.what: Props are in-world documents you can open. An item record says a ledger exists; a prop lets the reader read it. Rendered by renderProp() in index.html, styled by app/styles/systems/exhibits.css.
where_they_appear: Inline in any prose field, via the marker [[prop:<id>|visible text]] — becomes a clickable .proplink.
As a tile grid on the item page of every item listed in the prop's `items` array.
As an 'Exhibits' card at the foot of any article listed in the prop's `articles` array.
_README.adding_one: Add an object here, give it `kind`, `title`, `body` (HTML using the .pd-* classes) and at least one link in `items` or `articles`. No JS or CSS changes are needed. Keep the body factual to the source record — a prop is evidence, not new canon.
_README.stamps: Optional. `stamps: ["overdue"]` renders .pd-stamp--overdue. Available: overdue, paid, void, sealed, noaction, evidence.

prop_ebot_survey_iv.subtitle: The Old World Mapping Company · the sheet with one T
prop_ebot_survey_iv.note: The physical sheet is retained in the archive as evidence. The correction demand attached to it was never answered.
prop_ebot_survey_iv.body:

prop_ebot_correction_demand.title: Correction Demand — Sheet 41
prop_ebot_correction_demand.subtitle: Filed 1032 BF · acknowledged by a clerk · never answered
prop_ebot_correction_demand.note: The demand was posted, acknowledged, and never acted upon. The Company later burned down with its plates inside, which is why Survey Series IV can no longer be corrected by anybody at any price.
prop_ebot_correction_demand.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Office of the Auditor-General
To
The Works Manager, The Old World Mapping Company
Re
Survey Series IV, Sheet 41 — defective plate
Dated
19 Aethel, 1032 BF

Sir,

Your Sheet 41 names the mountain at the head of the Northern Reach MOUNT EBOT. The mountain is correctly Mount Ebot. The mountain your customers believe they are buying is Mount Ebott, which lies four hundred miles east of it, and which contains a barrier, a quantity of monsters, and a king with a beard.

Your cartouche offers corrections on application. This is the application.

On the seventeenth of this month a party of three reached the summit of your Sheet 41 on the strength of your spelling. A chartered aircraft was destroyed. A twenty-two-year-old man was opened above the eye by a thrown bone and dressed under an overhang in hail. He was promised nothing and has so far received it.

Waluigi does not ask for damages. Waluigi asks for a T.

Correct the plate. Reissue the sheet. Every copy still folded in a saddlebag is a hazard you engraved.

Waluigi
Auditor-General
 
For the Company — no reply received
Acknowledged by a clerk, 24 Aethel 1032. Nothing further. Works destroyed by fire; plates lost. — filed to archive 1040 BF

prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.title: Truth Ledger — Sworn Statements and Contradictions
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.subtitle: Maintained by Orvinder Danos, barrister · double-column form
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.note: It does not force truth magically in public records. Everyone around it simply behaves as though lying near it would be personally embarrassing.
prop_orvinder_truth_ledger.body:
Orvinder Danos, Barrister
Ledger of Sworn Statements · Contradictions Marked
DeponentSwornLater established
Witness AWas not present at the hour statedWas present; corrected on the second reading
Witness BNever handled the instrumentHandled it twice, both times gloved
Witness CCannot recall the sumRecalled the sum exactly when it was read back wrong
Witness DStatement withdrawn before entryWithdrawn; retained here because a withdrawal is also evidence
1. A statement entered in this ledger is entered in the deponent's own words and read back to the deponent before signature.
2. A contradiction is recorded in the right-hand column without comment. The column is not an accusation. The column is a column.
3. Nothing in this ledger protects the practitioner against a technically truthful evasion, and the practitioner should stop expecting it to.
O. Danos
Keeper of the ledger
A truth ledger is only as good as the person willing to read the ugly line twice. — W.

prop_rakka_silence_contract.title: Terms of Engagement — Silence Protocol
prop_rakka_silence_contract.subtitle: Employer copy · clause 7 is the one that matters
prop_rakka_silence_contract.note: Inferred from Rakka-related teleportation and silence references. If your employer has a silence protocol, your retirement plan is probably a shovel.
prop_rakka_silence_contract.body:
Terms of Engagement
Employer Copy · Not For Issue To The Engaged Party
Engaging party
Rakka
Engaged party
____________________ (completed on acceptance)
Term
Until concluded
1. The engaged party performs the work described and does not describe the work performed.
2. Payment is rendered on completion. Completion is determined by the engaging party.
4. Knowledge acquired incidentally in the course of the work remains the property of the engaging party.
6. The engaged party shall not be told the identity of other engaged parties, and shall not enquire.
7. Where the engaged party comes into possession of knowledge exceeding the scope of the engagement, the engagement converts to a matter of loose-end management, and the engaged party becomes the matter.
8. Clause 7 is not negotiable and is not discussed.
R.
For the engaging party
 
Engaged party — signature block left blank
This document is retained by the engaging party. No counterpart is issued. The absence of a counterpart is itself a term.
Nobody signs clause 7 sober. Nobody reads clause 7 twice. — W.

prop_ironhand_order_120.title: Order 120 — Quarantine of the North
prop_ironhand_order_120.subtitle: Signed by General Ironhand · tribunal exhibit
prop_ironhand_order_120.note: Ironhand chose to commit his atrocity to text, and text testifies. Some weapons have blades. This one has a nib and a body count.
prop_ironhand_order_120.body:
Restricted — Command Distribution Only
Iron Legion · Command
Standing Order Number 120
Issued by
General Ironhand, commanding
Occasion
Breach of Aegis Command; Planar Fracture at Raventree Manor
Effect
Legion Wall Checkpoint constituted a sealed quarantine
Distribution
Garrison commanders. Not for posting.
I. The northern line is closed. No writ, no passage, no exception granted at garrison level.
II. Travel writs are inspected at the checkpoint. Non-compliant operatives are detained, not turned back.
III. Detainee populations exceeding the capacity of the holding facility are to be reduced.
IV. Toad prisoners held under this order are to be executed. Commanders will not seek confirmation of this paragraph in writing a second time.
V. This order is effective on signature and remains effective until countermanded by the undersigned.
Ironhand
General, commanding
 
Countersignature — none required
Paragraph IV is four lines long and did not require him to raise his voice. That is the case. — W.
Exhibit · The People v. General Ironhand

prop_bloomia_rose_letter.title: The Winter Rose Letter
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.subtitle: Left by Bloomia · survival-coded · authenticates the witness
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.note: The message pointing toward the place where roses grow in winter. A flower clue is still a knife if the right people fear it.
prop_bloomia_rose_letter.body:
No letterhead · no direction · no signature

If this reaches the right hands it will mean nothing to the wrong ones, and that is the whole of my hope.

Ask for the place where roses grow in winter. Do not ask a lord. Ask someone who carries things and is not looked at.

The one who greets you there will not use my name. If they say the roses were planted for a wedding that did not happen, that is the sign, and you may say anything after it.

I am well. That is also a code, and I am sorry for it.

🌹
Unsigned — a drawn rose in place of a name
She wrote a location into a garden and trusted a servant over a court. Both decisions were correct. — W.

prop_tymnas_cookie_note.title: The Cookie Note
prop_tymnas_cookie_note.subtitle: Delivered with cookies by knights · signed O.T.
prop_tymnas_cookie_note.note: A cookie note should not be evidence. The Shadow Estate disagrees.
prop_tymnas_cookie_note.body:
for Tymnas

Your friends miss you. They said to bring these round and to say so out loud, so: they miss you.

Nobody could agree on what to call the group. Somebody said the Local Misfits. Somebody else said the Toad-Headed Heroes and was shouted down. It is written here as both because I was not going to referee it.

Come back when the house lets you.

— O.T.

Possibly sincere. Possibly bait. Definitely suspicious. The group-name confusion is the part that reads as real. — W.

prop_xo_stage_card.title: Stage Direction Card — Act Two
prop_xo_stage_card.subtitle: From X.O.'s deck · an operation written as a performance
prop_xo_stage_card.note: A god complex with cue cards is still a god complex. The cards are filed because the aesthetics are operational: when the staging is offended, the cruelty goes up.
prop_xo_stage_card.body:
ACT TWO

ENTRANCE. Not through the door. Through the door is what they are watching.

LIGHT. Behind. Always behind. A face explained is a face diminished.

THE LINE. Delivered once. If it must be repeated the scene has already failed and the failure is theirs.

THE FACE. Selected for the audience, not for the crime. Choose the one they will remember in the retelling.

IF INTERRUPTED. The interruption becomes the scene. Nothing is a mistake if it is committed to.

— CURTAIN HELD UNTIL THEY UNDERSTAND —

Read it twice. The fourth line selects a victim by how well they will describe the event afterwards. That is not vanity. That is target selection. — W.

prop_kamek_seal_rubbing.title: Seal Rubbing — The Notation Kamek Read As An Invitation
prop_kamek_seal_rubbing.subtitle: Charcoal on paper · annotated in a confident hand
prop_kamek_seal_rubbing.note: The greatest wizard in Koopa history versus a label. The label lost first, then everyone else did.
prop_kamek_seal_rubbing.body:
Rubbing, taken at the seal face
Charcoal on paper · scale unrecorded
Outer ring
Binding notation. Repeated without variation, which in ward-work means closed.
Middle ring
A dedication. Names the thing sealed, not the reader.
Inner mark
Read by the taker of this rubbing as a personal address.
Annotated on the original in a firm hand: “for me”. The inner mark is a dedication of the prison to what is inside it. It was never addressed to anybody holding a stick of charcoal.
Waluigi is not a ward scholar and says so on the record. Waluigi is, however, extremely experienced in reading a document as saying what one wishes it said, and this is a textbook specimen.

prop_toad_lee_diary_page.title: Diary Page — Lady Aurelian, on Grafting
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.subtitle: Preserved by Toad Lee, who read the plot
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.note: Toad Lee fell out a window, yes. He also read the important thing. Both facts can coexist, and only one of them is in this file.
prop_toad_lee_diary_page.body:
Diary of Lady Aurelian · loose page, preserved

They call it grafting, which is a gardener's word, and they chose it on purpose. A graft takes. A graft is not a wound, it is a joining, and the tree does not complain afterwards because the tree has nothing left to complain with.

What is joined is not the flesh. Anyone can join flesh. What is joined is the line — and a line that has been joined once can be joined again, which is the part they do not say aloud at the table.

The Legion watches the wrong end of it. They watch the bodies. The bodies are the least interesting part. Watch the blood-work, and watch who is keeping the record of it, because whoever keeps that record decides afterwards what happened.

A.
Unsigned beyond the initial
Reading is a combat skill. This page connects Legion observation to Corvinarus blood-work and it was recovered by the party member most famous for a window. — W.

prop_byscilla_disciplinary.title: Disciplinary Notice — The Bath Incident
prop_byscilla_disciplinary.subtitle: Danos command · issued in gloves, received in water
prop_byscilla_disciplinary.note: Some people need a sword. Byscilla needs gloves and disappointment. The notice is the disappointment, formalised.

Danos Command

Subject
Thornbury
Issued by
Byscilla Danos
Occasion
Extraction from a luxury bath during operational hours

prop_tea_syndicate_page.title: The Third Steeping — House Doctrine
prop_tea_syndicate_page.subtitle: A page from the Tea Leaf Syndicate book · read by Eager, absorbed by nobody
prop_tea_syndicate_page.note: Tea people made hot leaf water into doctrine. Waluigi is annoyed and impressed, in that order, and only just.
prop_tea_syndicate_page.body:
The Tea Leaf Syndicate
On the Third Steeping · House Doctrine, Article the Ninth
i. The first steeping is for the guest. It is courteous, it is weak, and it tells you nothing.
ii. The second steeping is for the table. By it a house is judged, and by it a house intends to be judged, which is why the second steeping is never the truth.
iii. The third steeping is for the business. It is taken after the guest has said the thing they came to say and before they have decided whether they meant it.
iv. A leaf held too long turns bitter and cannot be made sweet again by any subsequent kindness. The Syndicate applies this to leaves and to people and considers the comparison exact.
v. Serve the third steeping yourself. A cup poured by a servant is a cup poured by whoever pays the servant.
Preparations not found in polite markets are treated in Articles the Eleventh through Fourteenth, which are not reproduced here and which the archive has not seen.
Clause v is genuine operational security dressed as etiquette. Eager read this page and learned nothing, which is also data. — W.
